description: This file defines the interface for a reftable stack used in a Git-like version control system. It includes function declarations for creating, managing, iterating, compacting, and cleaning a stack of reftables stored on disk, as well as related data structures and macros.

methods.name: reftable_new_stack
methods.description: Creates a new reftable stack in the specified directory with given options.

methods.name: reftable_stack_next_update_index
methods.description: Retrieves the update index indicating where the next table should be written.

methods.name: reftable_stack_new_addition
methods.description: Begins a new transaction to add reftables to the stack, locking the ref database.

methods.name: reftable_addition_add
methods.description: Adds a reftable to the current transaction.

methods.name: reftable_addition_commit
methods.description: Commits the current transaction, releasing lock and finalizing additions.

methods.name: reftable_addition_destroy
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a transaction, optionally unlocking.

methods.name: reftable_stack_add
methods.description: Adds a new reftable to the stack via a supplied write function.

methods.name: reftable_stack_init_ref_iterator
methods.description: Initializes an iterator to traverse references in the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_init_log_iterator
methods.description: Initializes an iterator to traverse logs in the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_merged_table
methods.description: Returns the merged table used for seeking within the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_destroy
methods.description: Deallocates all resources associated with the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_reload
methods.description: Reloads the stack if out-of-date, very inexpensive if up-to-date.

methods.name: reftable_stack_compact_all
methods.description: Compacts all reftables into a single large table, with optional reflog expiry.

methods.name: reftable_stack_compaction_required
methods.description: Checks whether the stack requires compaction, using heuristics if specified.

methods.name: reftable_stack_auto_compact
methods.description: Heuristically performs unbalanced table stack compaction.

methods.name: reftable_stack_clean
methods.description: Removes stale reference tables.

methods.name: reftable_stack_read_ref
methods.description: Reads a single ref record from the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_read_log
methods.description: Reads a single log record from the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_compaction_stats
methods.description: Provides statistics on past compactions.

methods.name: reftable_stack_hash_id
methods.description: Returns a hash of the current stack for identification.

ctags.name: attempts
ctags.pattern: /^	int attempts; \/* how often we tried to compact *\/$/

ctags.name: bytes
ctags.pattern: /^	uint64_t bytes; \/* total number of bytes written *\/$/

ctags.name: entries_written
ctags.pattern: /^	uint64_t entries_written; \/* total number of entries written, including$/

ctags.name: failures
ctags.pattern: /^	int failures; \/* failures happen on concurrent updates *\/$/
